# Alegreya Sans, vendored

`AlegreyaSans-Regular.ttf`, `AlegreyaSans-Medium.ttf`, `AlegreyaSans-Italic.ttf`
and `OFL.txt` are unmodified from `ofl/alegreyasans/` of
<https://github.com/google/fonts>, commit `296bb4790d3f9bd95547c733708a3666ed35d844`.
SHA-256: Regular `8fab634196007afca839f1e5a6fb300976daff55d8528b590ef032f01b14ea10`,
Medium `4b89fe7804fd1485ec2757795a53ffdb66e1206dd56f844c2d72b3c944815b43`,
Italic `f49f6f2bdd84df850b25b0f8185d8a051e1d1eb2dd08e2f91b8c7b86d9a9e1a6`.
Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1.

The launcher's text face (states, notes, help), embedded in the `oracles` binary at build time
(`launcher/ui/ui_embed.cmake`). Its licence goes with it even embedded:
`OFL.txt` is copied beside the executable as `AlegreyaSans-OFL.txt`. To update:
replace the files and change this file.
